markdown: **Activate—Lightning Rod** <actions string="Reaction" /> ;   **Trigger** You take electricity damage;  **Effect** You gain [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 5 to the triggering damage, and the _fulmination fang_ crackles with the absorbed energy. You can [Interact](/Actions.aspx?ID=2297) to change between the gun sword’s current usage (melee to ranged, or ranged to melee). The next melee [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) you make with the fulmination fang within the next minute deals an additional 1d6 electricity damage. After a minute, the absorbed energy dissipates.
